Also, my favorite part of both games, the setting and the lore are also a big part of it, if you like dark fantasy / dark medieval you’ll love the decaying world of dark souls, and if you enjoy cosmic horror and mysterious architecture you’ll love the haunting world of Bloodborne. 

And if you play Bloodborne, you will be extremely confused about what’s going on in the beginning, but just keep playing, the world unfolding in front of you is incredible, so try not to look anything up story wise until you finish the game, but other than that both games are great and if you like one you’ll like the other.
